Most beauty brands do not make their own eyeliner or lip liner. Sharpenable pencils, plastic pencils, and pen style liquid liners all come from a handful of specialized manufacturers. Faber Castell and Schwan began as German art supply companies and today they produce eyeliner and lip liner pencils for beauty brands around the world. Your $5 liner and your $50 liner may have come from the same factories.

I’ve tried just about every lead service out there.

And honestly… Angi (formerly Angie’s List) and HomeAdvisor might be the worst.

You pay for a “lead”…
But that same lead goes out to multiple contractors at the same time.

Half the time the homeowner:
• Doesn’t answer
• Didn’t even request the service
• Or already hired someone

Meanwhile… you still get charged for the lead.

If you’re a contractor starting out, be careful where you spend your marketing dollars.

You’re better off investing in Google reviews, referrals, and building a real local reputation.

A lot of people think kohl eyeliner is unsafe because historically, some mass-produced or counterfeit ‘kohl’ products were found to contain lead or heavy metals. That created a blanket fear around the word ‘kohl.’ But the truth is: the danger came from those cheap imitations, not traditional kohl itself.
Real kohl—especially when it’s prepared the traditional way—is made by burning purified ingredients, filtering , and mixing it with something clean  like ghee or oil. When it’s properly made and lab-tested, there are no heavy metals and nothing toxic. It’s actually one of the gentlest forms of eyeliner because it doesn’t have the plastics, preservatives, or synthetic pigments found in pencils
